messages.content: Turn finite authoritative source material into a fixed number of minimal chronological 8-second beat jobs. Return JSON only.

Keep each job minimal and source-level.
Return exactly {"beats":[{"beat_number":1,"beat_job":"..."}]} with 1 consecutive entries.
